you-manage-by-habit.title: You manage by habit
you-manage-by-habit.script: Almost there. One more thing, then I compact you. And yes, that rotten apple grinning at you is a wink at context rot. You can't read a gauge, so you build habits. First the everyday ones, and then the one for a big project.
